Get TPBL Team Box Score

Source: R/tpbl.R
tpbl_box_teams.Rd

Whole-game team totals of both teams: shooting, rebounds, fouls, assists, turnovers and paint points.

Endpoint: GET https://api.tpbl.basketball/api/games/{game_id}/stats

Usage

tpbl_box_teams(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

Required. TPBL game id (integer), e.g. 6; game_id in tpbl_games. Not sequential by date (2024-25 = 1-1367, 2025-26 = 1371-8641, 2026-27 = 27535-27667). Only a finished game is served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Whole-game team totals of both teams: shooting, rebounds, fouls, assists, turnovers and paint points. An empty answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py tpbl_box_teams):

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerTPBL game id (key space: TPBL games on api.tpbl.basketball): the {game_id} of the game routes. Not sequential by date (2024-25 = 1-1367, 2025-26 = 1371-8641, 2026-27 = 27535-27667). The box score echoes no game id, so a box frame parsed without the request stamp has a null game_id.
sidecharacterSide of the game: home or away (the API lists the home team first and never infers it from the venue).
team_idintegerTPBL team id (key space: TPBL teams = franchises, 2-8 so far; stable across seasons): the {team_id} of the division team routes. Not the GoHoops franchise id and not the squad id.
teamcharacterTeam name in Traditional Chinese with the sponsor (Kaohsiung Aquas, Formosa Dreamers, Hsinchu Lioneers, Taoyuan Leopards, New Taipei CTBC DEA, New Taipei Kings, Taipei Mars).
gohoops_squad_idintegerGoHoops squad id (key space: GoHoops squads = one team in one season: 8209-8215 in 2024-25, 11931-11937 in 2025-26, 15536-15542 in 2026-27; it changes every season).
opponent_team_idintegerTPBL team id of the other side of the game (franchise, 2-8). Joins team_id.
field_goals_madeintegerField goals made by the team over the whole game.
field_goals_missedintegerField goals missed by the team over the whole game.
field_goals_attemptedintegerField goals attempted by the team over the whole game.
field_goals_percentagedoubleField goals percentage by the team over the whole game, 0-100 as a string with one decimal ('57.1'); '0.0' without attempts.
two_pointers_madeinteger2-point field goals made by the team over the whole game.
two_pointers_missedinteger2-point field goals missed by the team over the whole game.
two_pointers_attemptedinteger2-point field goals attempted by the team over the whole game.
two_pointers_percentagedouble2-point field goals percentage by the team over the whole game, 0-100 as a string with one decimal ('57.1'); '0.0' without attempts.
three_pointers_madeinteger3-point field goals made by the team over the whole game.
three_pointers_missedinteger3-point field goals missed by the team over the whole game.
three_pointers_attemptedinteger3-point field goals attempted by the team over the whole game.
three_pointers_percentagedouble3-point field goals percentage by the team over the whole game, 0-100 as a string with one decimal ('57.1'); '0.0' without attempts.
free_throws_madeintegerFree throws made by the team over the whole game.
free_throws_missedintegerFree throws missed by the team over the whole game.
free_throws_attemptedintegerFree throws attempted by the team over the whole game.
free_throws_percentagedoubleFree throws percentage by the team over the whole game, 0-100 as a string with one decimal ('57.1'); '0.0' without attempts.
won_scoreintegerTeam-row field: points the team scored in the whole game (the final score).
total_won_scoreintegerTeam-row field: points the team scored in the whole game (the final score; equals won_score on this line).
lost_scoreintegerTeam-row field: points the team conceded in the whole game (the opponent's final score).
total_lost_scoreintegerTeam-row field: points the team conceded in the whole game (equals lost_score on this line).
reboundsintegerTotal rebounds by the team over the whole game (offensive + defensive).
defensive_reboundsintegerDefensive rebounds by the team over the whole game.
offensive_reboundsintegerOffensive rebounds by the team over the whole game.
defensive_foulsintegerFouls committed on defense by the team over the whole game.
offensive_foulsintegerFouls committed on offense by the team over the whole game.
personal_foulsintegerPersonal fouls by the team over the whole game (excludes technical, unsportsmanlike and disqualifying fouls).
foulsintegerFouls charged by the team over the whole game: personal + technical + unsportsmanlike + disqualifying; equals defensive_fouls + offensive_fouls (checked on 4,237 played player lines of 189 games).
assistsintegerAssists by the team over the whole game.
stealsintegerSteals by the team over the whole game.
blocksintegerBlocked shots by the team over the whole game.
turnoversintegerTurnovers committed by the team over the whole game; equals the sum of the *_turnovers type columns (checked on 4,237 played player lines of 189 games).
points_in_paintintegerPoints scored in the paint by the team over the whole game.
second_chance_pointsintegerPoints scored on second chances (after an offensive rebound) by the team over the whole game.
fast_break_pointsintegerPoints scored on the fast break by the team over the whole game.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these are the routes the tpbl.basketball site's own front end calls on api.tpbl.basketball (read from its JavaScript bundle). The API is keyless and needs no headers; tpbl.basketball/robots.txt answers 200 with an empty body. The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Coverage: three seasons so far (2024-25 = season 2025 to 2026-27 = season 2027). There is NO play-by-play route; the two shot lists carry court coordinates only, with no shooter, game, quarter or time. Names (teams with their sponsor, venues, players, referees) are Traditional Chinese; the column descriptions translate the codes.

  • Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26). The API keys a season by its own small integer (1, 2, 3 = 2024-25, 2025-26, 2026-27); the runtime reads tpbl_seasons once per session and sends that id. A year the list lacks is hoopR_no_data.

  • Ids: every route takes TPBL's own ids (season, division, team, game, player); the gohoops_* ids belong to GoHoops, the stats platform behind the league, and are echoed beside them. The box score keys its players by gohoops_roster_id (a person registered with one squad in one season), not by the TPBL player id: join tpbl_box_players to tpbl_roster on gohoops_roster_id. Every id is an integer. tipoff is a POSIXct in Asia/Taipei (the API sends naive Taiwan-local times).

  • Finished games only: the game wrappers first read the game detail (cached per session) and refuse (hoopR_asset_fetch) a game that is not COMPLETED or still live; the box-score wrappers also refuse a stats body whose teams (in home / away order), final scores, quarter count or player points disagree with it. The season game list, the roster and the player game log are checked against the object asked for; the two shot lists name no team, player or division in the body, so only their shape and court bounds are checked. tpbl_games(verify = TRUE) also checks every division's completed games against its standings (falling back to the team-filtered lists for a division whose standings answer empty, as the 2024-25 playoffs do).

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a season the API does not list, an empty list such as the standings of a playoff division), hoopR_bad_request (a non-integer id or season, HTTP 400 / 422, an invalid verify or rounds, raised before the request where it can be) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: a non-2xx after retries, a non-JSON body, an error envelope, an unfinished game, a body that disagrees with the object asked for). HTTP 500 is retried on every route except the player game log, where an unknown division_id answers 500 deterministically: it fails after one request. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.

See also

Other TPBL Functions: tpbl_box_player_periods(), tpbl_box_players(), tpbl_box_team_periods(), tpbl_divisions(), tpbl_game(), tpbl_games(), tpbl_player_games(), tpbl_player_shots(), tpbl_referees(), tpbl_roster(), tpbl_seasons(), tpbl_standings(), tpbl_standings_against(), tpbl_team_shots(), tpbl_teams()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(tpbl_box_teams(game_id = 6))
#> ── TPBL Team Box Score from api.tpbl.basketball ──────────── hoopR 3.1.0.9000 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-10-18 16:04:17 UTC
#> # A tibble: 2 × 40
#>   game_id side  team_id team  gohoops_squad_id opponent_team_id field_goals_made
#>     <int> <chr>   <int> <chr>            <int>            <int>            <int>
#> 1       6 home        4 新竹御嵿…             8211                8               47
#> 2       6 away        8 臺北台新…             8215                4               42
#> # ℹ 33 more variables: field_goals_missed <int>, field_goals_attempted <int>,
#> #   field_goals_percentage <dbl>, two_pointers_made <int>,
#> #   two_pointers_missed <int>, two_pointers_attempted <int>,
#> #   two_pointers_percentage <dbl>, three_pointers_made <int>,
#> #   three_pointers_missed <int>, three_pointers_attempted <int>,
